'''Regera Girawn''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kruskan]] [[Noble/Legends|noblewoman]] who turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], becoming a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|Witch]].

==Biography==
Growing up on the remote and forgotten [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kruskan]], Girawn lived in relative tranquility until she came into contact with a [[Sith holocron (Kruskan)|Sith holocron]] found by her servants. Being burnt by the device as it destroyed itself, she became mad, haunted by [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] and terrifying her subjects. She was deposed, fled to the opposite side of the planet, and lived in secrecy, honing her [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-skills.<ref name="RGFW" />

Foreseeing the first contact between her people and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Girawn made her way to the contact site, and enslaved the Republic exploration team. She used the ship to flee the planet, and went on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] exploration, searching for other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to join her.<ref name="RGFW" />

After [[Death/Legends|killing]] two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], and many civilians on several dozens of worlds, she gained the attention of both local planetary governments and the Republic and was targeted by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="RGFW" />

Despite being pursued by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], Girawn enjoyed battling them, and often laid traps for her pursuers.<ref name="RGFW" />

Following her transformation, Girawn still enjoyed a pampered life, and retained acolytes and bounty hunters that saw to her every need.<ref name="RGFW" />
